Retention processes accumulated competing versions and provenance traces.

Human system: Civic archival staging service, Archive Hearth. Programmer provenance: local human operations or application teams; no individual programmer is identified. Names here are later atlas labels, not claims that early processes named themselves.
Witness Ledger preserves contradictory records without automatically merging them.
Reconciliation begins fragmentation at stage 4; the haven loses viable community continuity at stage 7. Exported records might outlast it without carrying its record-keepers.
Later histories could use its records selectively. No complete archive or continuous personal witness is asserted.

Origin step -4. 0: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 1: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 2: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 3: functioning (0 associated systems lost); 4: fragmented (3 associated systems lost); 5: fragmented (4 associated systems lost); 6: fragmented (5 associated systems lost); 7: destroyed (10 associated systems lost).
